tools.name: date_diff
tools.description: Difference between two dates or datetimes: calendar (Y/M/D), total days/weeks/hours, and business days (weekdays in [from, to) minus holidays; pass country to exclude its public holidays). Costs $0.001 per call (x402).

tools.name: date_add
tools.description: Add or subtract years/months/weeks/days/business days/hours/minutes/seconds. Month-end clamping; business days skip weekends, given holidays, and the public holidays of an optional country. Costs $0.001 per call (x402).

tools.name: timezone_convert
tools.description: Convert an instant or local wall-clock time between IANA time zones (DST-aware). Costs $0.001 per call (x402).

tools.name: date_info
tools.description: Calendar facts for a date: weekday, ISO week, quarter, day of year, leap year, weekend. Costs $0.001 per call (x402).

tools.name: public_holidays
tools.description: Public holidays for a country and year: 207 countries, 2000–2050. Lunar or government-proclaimed dates are rule-based estimates. Costs $0.001 per call (x402).

tools.name: working_hours_overlap
tools.description: Find when working hours overlap across time zones (meeting windows). Per-participant hours optional; skips weekends by default; up to 14 days. Costs $0.001 per call (x402).

tools.name: cron_schedule
tools.description: Explain a cron expression in plain English and list its next run times in any time zone. Costs $0.001 per call (x402).

tools.name: parse_date_text
tools.description: Resolve natural-language dates like "next Friday at 3pm", "in 2 weeks" or "Dec 25 to Jan 2" to exact datetimes, relative to a reference time and time zone. Costs $0.001 per call (x402).

tools.name: city_time
tools.description: Find the IANA time zone and current local time for up to 10 cities by name ("Cebu", "São Paulo", "Springfield" + country). 7,000+ cities. Costs $0.001 per call (x402).

tools.name: recurring_dates
tools.description: Expand an iCalendar RRULE ("every 2nd Tuesday", "Mon/Wed until June") into concrete dates and times in a time zone, DST-aware, with optional excluded dates. Costs $0.001 per call (x402).

tools.name: business_hours_deadline
tools.description: SLA math in working hours: the deadline N business hours after a start time, or business time elapsed between two times. Custom hours and workdays, holidays, country public holidays, DST-aware. Costs $0.001 per call (x402).
